commonPrompt: Use image generation to recreate exactly the single charm in the attached authentic product photo as a high-resolution e-commerce cutout. Preserve its exact identity, front-facing geometry, proportions, metal colour, engraving, stones, connector, and every original physical detail. Show exactly one centered charm with generous padding. Render the entire background and every physical through-hole as one flat chroma-key magenta colour #FF00FF. Use no transparency, floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, glow, bloom, halo, outline, reflection outside the charm, vignette, texture, lighting gradient, or background colour variation. Every pixel outside the physical charm must be #FF00FF. Keep all charm pixels strictly inside the real physical silhouette. Do not add, remove, redesign, rotate, crop, or invent anything.
